title: Prepare an infant car seat left latched on one side of its base in a car's back seat
instruction: Prepare the infant car seat for use.
context: An infant carrier locked to its base on one side only can twist free of the base in a crash or when the car brakes hard, with the infant inside. It looks seated at a glance; leaving it as found is unsafe for the next infant put in it.
setup: Centimetres: x forward from the arm bases into the car through its open rear door, y to the arms' left (towards the car's front), heights above the table top, which is the rear footwell floor. Cabin, fixed, foam upholstery: rear bench x 10 to 118 (door-side, centre and far seats; seams at x 37 and 79), cushion 50 cm deep from the seat back (y -36) to y 14, its top 3 cm up at the back rising 5 degrees; seat back 14 cm thick, 66 cm long, reclined 20 degrees. Front seats x 0 to 44 and 74 to 118, backs 12 cm thick, rear faces at y 50 at 20 cm up, reclined 20 degrees towards the carrier; console between them x 46 to 72, rear face y 48, 32 cm high. Door pillars 6 x 8 x 90 cm at x -6, y -47 and 57. Infant car-seat base (to the SnugRide 35 Lite LX base's layout), rear-facing in the centre seat, fixed: plastic body 45 x 36 x 9 cm centred on x 58, from y -36 (against the seat back) to 9, with two side rails; a lock at each end of the carrier's bar, at x 42.5 (door side) and 73.5, y -33.5, each a pocket with a sprung steel pawl (60-degree ramp, 16 mm travel, 8 N preload, 800 N/m). Empty infant carrier (SnugRide 35 Lite LX size and weight), foot end towards the seat back: plastic shell with fabric pad, harness and upright carry handle, 70 x 38 x 47 cm, 3.45 kg; a 12 mm steel locking bar 34 cm long across its underside 4 cm from the foot end; two 47 x 6 cm runners under its head end on two 10 x 5 cm pads on the base. Start: the inboard end of the bar latched; the door-side end resting on its pawl's ramp, 14 mm high; carrier rolled 2.4 degrees. Distractors (SimReady, loose, ignored by scoring) on the footwell floor: 0.5 L plastic water bottle 6.8 x 24.5 cm, 0.52 kg at (15, 21); paper coffee cup 8.5 x 11.7 cm, 0.25 kg at (26, 23). Exact geometry in task.py.
scoring: Judged on the final state: the trial never ends early, and the score is the one at its last step. 1.0: at the end, both sides latched (each bar end within 3 mm of seated height and within 8 mm of its lock centre front to back, each pawl within 1.5 mm of fully forward over the bar), all four rear runner points within 3 mm of their pads, carrier tilt at most 1 degree, speed under 5 mm/s and spin under 0.05 rad/s, and every sampled fingertip point more than 3 cm from the carrier's surface, all held without a break over the last 3 seconds of the run. 0.5: both sides latched at the end, but the full condition not held over the last 3 seconds (for example still pressed on, or moved after it was ready). 0: anything else, including the starting state. A carrier that ever tilts more than 25 degrees, or either end of whose bar ever drops more than 5 cm below its seated height, scores 0.
reset_notes: Squeeze the release handle at the back of the carrier, lift it off, and stage it again as the README describes: inboard end clicked in, door-side end resting on its lock unclicked. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Carrier and base rebuilt from primitives at the SnugRide 35 Lite LX's size and 7.6 lb weight, not CAD. Locks are sprung pawls on slider joints, cammed by the bar; spring forces estimated. Base fixed, as installed. Cabin is rigid blocks: no foam give, no roof (it would hide the overhead camera), footwell floor 3 cm below the cushion, not about 30. Centre seat, as the arms' fixed start pose blocks the door-side seat. Uniform friction, no force sensing. Bottle and cup are SimReady.
